ig_caption:
1.7 GB Docker image. For 8 lines of Python. 🐳

AI wrote this Dockerfile:
⚠️ the full python:3.12 base image
⚠️ compilers, curl and git installed, and all shipped to production

Every deploy pulls ~1.7 GB, and every extra package is one more thing to patch.

The fix:
✅ python:3.12-slim
✅ multi-stage build, so build tools stay in stage 1
✅ pip --no-cache-dir
✅ a non-root user

Same app → 199 MB. About 8x smaller.

Save this for your next build 🔖 and follow for more fixes like this.

- Fixed (python:3.12-slim, multi-stage, --no-cache-dir, non-root user): 199 MB, still answers /health

Smaller images mean faster deploys and fewer packages to patch.
